Sources read on sec.gov: the FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001467858-26-000013, filed January 27, 2026) and the 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001467858-26-000022, filed April 20, 2026). OWNERSHIP: Mary Barra (Chair and Chief Executive Officer) beneficially owned 1,658,807 shares as of April 6, 2026, including 840,262 shares from options exercisable within 60 days of April 1, 2026. The proxy marks it * (less than 1%), so pctEconomic is null. HOLDERS: the 2026 proxy names only BlackRock (8.3%, holdings as of March 31, 2025) and State Street (5.2%, as of September 30, 2025) above 5%; Vanguard, listed at 11.6% in the 2025 proxy, is no longer named. DIVIDENDS: $538 million paid on common stock, per Note 20 and the 'Cash dividends paid on common stock' line in the statement of equity. The cash-flow 'Dividends paid' line ($657 million) also includes $119 million of dividends to noncontrolling interests, so it is not used. BUYBACKS: the cash-flow line ($6,012 million) includes payments under accelerated share repurchase programs; it excludes the $29 million 'Issuance (redemption) of subsidiary stock' line. STOCK COMP: $334 million is the stated expense for GM stock incentive awards; Cruise's share-based award expense was described as 'insignificant' for 2025. XBRL also carries $531 million of stock-based compensation in the statement of equity (an APIC adjustment), which is not used. GEOGRAPHY: four rows as reported; the filing gives no combined U.S. / non-U.S. total. No employee stock purchase plan is described in the 10-K, so plan is null.
